Agenda Item 12 General Written Public Comments

The Tahoe Regional Planning Agency (TRPA) appreciates and considers all input from the public. Public comments are welcome by virtual and in-person attendees at the beginning and end of every meeting. We encourage you to submit written comment (email, mail, or fax) well in advance of the meeting date to give staff adequate time to process.

  • Please submit written comments by 3:00 p.m. the day before the meeting.
  • You may email comments to [email protected]. Include meeting details and agenda item in the subject line or write “General Comment” for non-agenda items.
  • You may also send by mail, fax to (775) 588-4527, or drop off in person at 128 Market Street.

Public comments uploaded here are listed with the most recent comments first of the time they are received. To view the most up to date public comment documents, it may be necessary to clear your web browser cache.
